merger_name: Amwins / Dragoneer / KKR / Temasek Consortium – Steadfast

anzsic_codes.name: Other Auxiliary Finance and Investment Services

merger_description:
Starboard BidCo Pty Ltd (**BidCo**), an entity indirectly owned by investment funds, vehicles and/or accounts managed by and/or affiliated with Dragoneer Investment Group, LLC (**Dragoneer**) and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co L.P. (**KKR**), and funded in part by Amwins Group, Inc (**Amwins**) (through certain of its affiliates), proposes to acquire 100% of the equity in Steadfast Group Limited (**Steadfast**) pursuant to a scheme of arrangement (the **Transaction**).

  

Temasek Holdings (Private) Limited (**Temasek**) will also acquire a minority, non-controlling indirect economic interest in BidCo as part of the consortium acquisition of Steadfast.  


Following completion of the Transaction, the Steadfast business will immediately separate such that Amwins will acquire the Steadfast underwriting business and certain wholesale broking businesses outside of Australia while BidCo will retain the remainder of Steadfast, including the balance of Steadfast's broking business and complementary businesses (the **Separation**).  


Together, the Transaction and the Separation will be referred to as the **Acquisition**.

  

Steadfast is an ASX-listed company that supplies insurance intermediary services, operating insurance broker and underwriting agency networks predominantly in Australia and New Zealand. Steadfast also provides market access, technology, risk solutions and operational support to support the broker and agency business in its network.

  

Amwins is a global wholesale distributor of specialty insurance products and services headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, United States. Amwins provides distribution, underwriting, administrative and actuarial services by acting as a wholesale broker or managing general agent with delegated authority from insurance carriers, with international operations across 8 countries.

  

Dragoneer is a United States investment firm based in San Francisco, California. The firm focuses on technology investments in public and private markets globally. Dragoneer currently acts as investment adviser to a number of open and closed-end funds, co-investment vehicles and separately managed accounts. In 2015, Dragoneer acquired a minority stake in Amwins.

  

KKR is a global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds.

  

Temasek is an investment company headquartered in Singapore. Temasek's global portfolio covers a broad spectrum of industries: Transportation & Industrials; Financial Services; Telecommunications, Media & Technology; Consumer & Real Estate; as well as Life Sciences & Agri-Food.
